d: Rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ke vidhan parshad (MLC) aur biskoman ke purv cheyarmain sunil sinh se pravartan nideshalay (ED) ne patna sthit karyalay men karib 8 ghante tak lanbi puchhtachh ki hai. yah puchhtachh patna sthit biskoman (BISCOMAUN) men chana dal ki kharid-bikri men huee kathit vittiy aniymittaon ke mamle men ki gaee hai.
